assumptions: Revenue calculated as SUM(quantity * unit_price) from order_lines for the specified SKU.
No adjustments for returns; returns table not applied.
No filtering by order status; all orders included.
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) AS total_cents,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.sku = 'NC-BRG-08';
